title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: schema recommendations for custom connectors in the admin centre
summary: The briefing's mixed licensing classification does not match an administrative view inside the already licensed connectors product. The roadmap facts, navigation and schema-update API are supported, but the licensing field needs correction and several qualifications should be tightened.

claims.claim: The roadmap associates this capability with Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]

claims.where: front matter: status; What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development, although Learn documents the recommendations as an admin-center feature.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.claim: The roadmap target is September CY2025.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "September CY2025"

claims.claim: The record gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: releasePhase; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Targeted Release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Targeted Release"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Developer and Web platforms.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Developer", "Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap proposes schema suggestions tailored to the connector being built.
claims.quote: Proposed schema suggestions tailored to the connector you’re building.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans real-time recommendations to identify schema gaps or errors.
claims.quote: Real-time recommendations to identify gaps or errors in your schema design to help improve search and chat results in Copilot.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center provides schema recommendations for published custom Copilot connectors.
claims.quote: To help you get started, the Microsoft 365 admin center provides schema recommendations for published custom connectors.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Recommendations analyse the schema and highlight missing labels used by Copilot to understand, rank and cite content.
claims.quote: Schema recommendations analyze your connector schema and highlight missing semantic labels for key properties that Copilot relies on to understand, rank, and cite content.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Accessing and managing connectors requires the AI administrator role.
claims.quote: To access and manage your Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors, you must be an AI administrator for your organization.
claims.fix: Keep the AI administrator requirement, but add: 'The cited Graph connection-management guide instead says a search admin can view and manage all tenant connections; the Microsoft guidance differs on the role.' The differing page is https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/connecting-external-content-manage-connections.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The current check covers title, url, lastModifiedBy and lastModifiedDateTime.
claims.quote:
Schema recommendations currently check for four missing semantic labels:
- **`title`**
- **`url`**
- **`lastModifiedBy`**
- **`lastModifiedDateTime`**

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The recommendations are not exhaustive and do not replace full schema design guidance.
claims.quote: Schema recommendations aren't exhaustive and don't replace the full schema design guidance for Copilot connectors.

claims.claim: The administrative schema-recommendations feature has a mixed licensing model.
claims.quote: Page field: model: "mixed". Microsoft: "Your tenant must have Microsoft 365 licenses." The standard assigns included to a new option inside a product covered by its general licensing requirement.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Keep the existing notes naming Microsoft 365 licenses and distinguishing the unpublished recommendation-specific licence; the table's alternative licences govern downstream connector experiences, not a mixed entitlement for this administrative view.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the recommendations' default state on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: 'custom Copilot connectors schema recommendations API read recommendations disable default automatically admin center' and '"schema recommendations" rollout future additional labels custom connectors default'; read manage-connector, view-details and roadmap. No default stated.

claims.claim: The title label is required for meaningful rendering and relevant Copilot results.
claims.quote: **`title`** – Semantically indexes the primary display name of an item. Required for meaningful result rendering and relevant Copilot results.

claims.claim: The url label is required for Copilot citations linking to the source system.
claims.quote: **`url`** – Identifies the canonical link to the source item. Required for Copilot citations to link back to the source system.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Connectors > Your Connections > connection reaches the detail panel containing recommendations.
claims.quote: Go to **Copilot** > **Connectors** > **Your Connections**. Select the connection that you want to modify. Schema recommendations can be accessed via the connection detail panel.

claims.claim: Adding labels changes how connector content is indexed and surfaced.
claims.quote: When you build a custom Copilot connector, the schema you define determines how your content is indexed and surfaced in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.fix: Replace the opening clause with 'Semantic labels help Copilot understand, rank and cite connector content'. The cited overview at https://learn.microsoft.com/plugins/overview-copilot-connector explicitly says 'Semantic labels are used for filtering and don't affect semantic indexing', so do not imply that label changes alter semantic indexing.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Deployed connectors are tenant-wide unless external item security is restricted.
claims.quote: Deployed connectors are tenant-wide unless external item security is restricted.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A person or application changes the schema to assign missing semantic labels.
claims.quote: You can assign or remove semantic labels. These labels influence experiences such as **Relevance** and **Viva Topics**.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/connecting-external-content-manage-schema to sources, titled 'Register and manage schema for the Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors'; it explicitly documents adding or removing labels on an existing schema.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Editing a connection might trigger a full crawl where applicable.
claims.quote: Editing a connection might trigger a full crawl, where applicable. However, during the initial full crawl, editing the connection doesn't trigger another full crawl.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Syncing is the displayed connection state for a connector crawling source data.
claims.quote: Syncing - The connector crawls the data from the source to index the existing items and make any updates.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A connectors tenant must have Microsoft 365 licenses.
claims.quote: Your tenant must have Microsoft 365 licenses.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The available Microsoft Search, Copilot grounding and Copilot Chat agent experiences depend on licensing.
claims.quote: The surfaces available to your users (Microsoft Search, Microsoft 365 Copilot grounding, Copilot Chat agents) and the connector types you can deploy depend on your organization's licensing.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 plus the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on supports synced connector grounding and agents.
claims.quote: | Microsoft 365 + Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 E7 supports synced connector grounding and agents.
claims.quote: | Microsoft 365 E7 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

claims.claim: Indexing synced connector data incurs no extra cost for tenants with Microsoft 365 licenses.
claims.quote: Indexing of synced connector data incurs no extra cost for tenants with Microsoft 365 licenses.

claims.claim: PATCH /v1.0/external/connections/{id}/schema updates a connection schema and can add labels.
claims.quote: Create a new or update an existing schema for a Microsoft Search connection. PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/external/connections/contosohr/schema
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged. Replace the first sentence of controls[1].note with 'The request body sets properties[].labels on the schema properties to add the missing semantic labels.' The cited reference's example uses properties entries containing labels.

claims.claim: The schema-update request body supplies a schema object.
claims.quote: In the request body, supply a JSON representation of a schema object.

claims.claim: ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy is the least privileged permission for schema updates.
claims.quote: | Application | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All |

claims.claim: ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All is a higher privileged permission for schema updates.
claims.quote: | Delegated (work or school account) | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All |

claims.claim: An API for reading schema recommendations is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'custom Copilot connectors schema recommendations API read recommendations disable default automatically admin center'; read manage-connector, Graph patch-schema, schema resource and manage-connections. Found reading/updating schemas, not recommendation retrieval.

claims.claim: An admin-center control for updating a published custom connector's schema to add labels is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'custom Copilot connector edit schema semantic labels Microsoft 365 admin center UI'; read manage-connector, manage-search-schema and Graph manage-schema. UI update guidance covers Microsoft-built connectors; SDK label assignment describes setup, not published custom schema updates.

claims.claim: No switch to turn schema recommendations off is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'custom Copilot connectors schema recommendations API read recommendations disable default automatically admin center'; read manage-connector and Graph schema references. The Copilot Visibility toggle governs connector content, not schema recommendations.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence specific to the schema-recommendations view is published.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot connector schema recommendations licensing price meter Microsoft 365'; read connectors prerequisites and manage-connector, plus returned licensing excerpts. Product and connector-experience licences are stated, but no recommendation-specific licence is named.

claims.claim: No meter specific to schema recommendations is published.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot connector schema recommendations licensing price meter Microsoft 365'; read prerequisites and manage-connector and search excerpts for Plan licensing and cost. No meter for analysing schemas or viewing recommendations was stated.

claims.claim: The record and feature documentation do not state rollout mechanics for schema recommendations.
claims.quote: Searched: '"schema recommendations" rollout future additional labels custom connectors default'; read the roadmap and manage-connector. The record gives target, phases and platforms; neither gives a rollout sequence or deployment mechanism for recommendations.

claims.claim: Learn does not state whether the recommendation checks will expand beyond the current four labels.
claims.quote: Searched: '"schema recommendations" rollout future additional labels custom connectors default'; read manage-connector and returned schema-guidance excerpts. Found current checks and broader label guidance, not a plan to expand recommendation checks.

claims.claim: The connection-operations table lists schema editing for connectors by Microsoft.
claims.quote: | Edit a published connection | ✔️ Name and description ✔️ Connection settings ✔️ Property labels ✔️ Schema ✔️ Refresh schedule ✔️ Query string (ServiceNow) ✔️ Advanced criteria (ServiceNow) ✔️ User mapping (ServiceNow) | ✔️ Name ✔️ Description |

claims.claim: The connection-operations table lists only name and description editing for connectors by partners.
claims.quote: Connectors by partners: ✔️ Name ✔️ Description

claims.claim: The connection-operations table does not list custom connectors as a separate category.
claims.quote: | Operation | Connectors by Microsoft | Connectors by partners |

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to confirm AI administrator assignments without a corresponding role-assignment control row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Confirm who holds the AI administrator role'. The controls table contains only viewing recommendations and changing schemas.
claims.fix: Replace that checklist bullet with 'Arrange for an AI administrator to review the recommendations.' This preserves the verified prerequisite without asking readers to inspect an unlisted role-assignment control.

controlChecks.governs: Viewing schema recommendations for a published custom connector
Changing a connection's schema to add the missing labels
